name: Bairong AI Inc.
summary: Bairong AI Inc., an investment holding company, operates as an artificial intelligence (AI) technology services company in China. It offers MaaS (Model as a Service), which leverages discriminant AI to digitalize the know-your-customer and know-your-product process for enterprises by analyzing users' risk, willingness, and capability; and BaaS (Business as a Service) that uses discriminant AI to analyze and stratify users into groups, as well as develops generative AI-powered chatbots using human natural languages to interact with users. The company also provides banking, consumer finance, wealth management, financial leasing, and e-commerce industry digital intelligence services. In additio…
